pages.title: Introduction
pages.text: Spices are mostly harvested from a plant. For some spices that may be a crop or a bush, for others they might grow as trees (bark or fruiting leaves).

pages.title: Tiers
pages.text: Spices fall into one of four tiers; $(#8C7A5B)Common$(), $(#C9A227)Uncommon$(), $(#3FA7B5)Rare$() and $(#9B4FC9)Epic$().$(br)By default, $(#8C7A5B)Common$() and $(#C9A227)Uncommon$() crops count as hardy.

pages.title: Spice Items
pages.text: Spices are plentiful when $(l:exploration/spice_regions)exploring the overworld$(), but spice plants can only be found naturally in their designated $(l:exploration/spice_regions)regions.$()

pages.title: Agriculture
pages.text: Once found, hardy plants can be grown anywhere, while the others will need to be grown where they were found. Some of the highest tier spices like $(l:spices/epic/saffron)Saffron$() and $(l:spices/epic/vanilla)Vanilla$() prevent any automation from harvesting them, instead requiring a player to hand-pick them.
